evidence: Surface morphology and roughness were observed by AFM (Psia, XE-200). Crystallanity of the thin films was measured by X-ray diffraction (XRD; Rigaku Co. Japan, D/MAX-3C, Cu Ka = 1.5405 A˚ , 30 KV and 15 mA). Film thickness was measured by ellipsometer (Woollam, M-2000V) and the chemical composition of the surface was studied by XPS spectrometer (VG Scientific, ESCALAB 250).
